title: 谷歌全球启动“自愿买断”计划：AI 狂烧 2000 亿美元，最高补偿 12 个月工资
summary: 谷歌全球启动“自愿买断”计划以对冲 AI 资本开支压力——在 2000 亿美元量级的 AI 投入下，离职员工最高可拿 12 个月工资补偿（InfoQ 中文，11-06 08:00）。
summary_en: Google has reportedly launched a global voluntary buyout program amid pressure from heavy AI capital expenditure. According to an InfoQ Chinese report dated 11-06 at 08:00, the company is investing around $200 billion in AI, while departing employees may receive severance of up to 12 months’ salary. The note attributes the initiative to concerns about AI-related spending pressure.
body:
